# GETAWAY phone app artwork

Generated with the built-in image_gen tool, one image per app. Final site assets are 256 × 256 PNG exports for phone displays; original generated images remain in work/phone-icon-assets.

## Exact prompt set

- [Quests, Dispatch, and Map prompts](prompts.txt) — the selected Map uses the final opaque-background correction.
- [Garage, Apartment, and People prompts](places-prompts.json)

Creative direction: dimensional emblems, navy outlines, jewel backgrounds, warm highlights, readable at phone size, and no lettering.
